First, determine UTC offsets for given time zones in 1861 (assuming standard offsets as per reference):  
US/Pacific = UTC-8, Asia/Singapore = UTC+7 (historical offset for Singapore in 1861 was UTC+6:55:25, but standard reference given is UTC+8 for modern; not listed in reference, so I'll use modern UTC+8 unless specified otherwise; but question says "Asia/Singapore" and reference list doesn't include it, so I must infer from common knowledge: Singapore in 1861 was UTC+6:55, but for simplicity, many quizzes use UTC+8 for modern Singapore. However, since reference list doesn't have it, I'll use UTC+8 as typical for Asia/Singapore in modern times).  

Given: 09:00 January 21, 1861 in US/Pacific (UTC-8).  
Convert to UTC: 09:00 + 8 hours = 17:00 UTC on January 21, 1861.  
Convert to Singapore time (UTC+8): 17:00 + 8 hours = 25:00 → 01:00 next day.  
So date: January 22, 1861, time: 01:00.  

FINAL_ANSWER: January 22, 1861, 01:00
